source: psz-re — four free-field savestates from kion, 2026-07-29

access.correction: an earlier note used a single deref and read 0x00FF00FF as the count. FUN_0206D60C derefs the pointer once at 0x0206D642 before the call, and FUN_02032C10 derefs it again. Reading the call site in ASM settled it; the decompiler's *DAT_ notation hid the second one.
access.record: 0x34 = 52 bytes, first 20 bytes are the descriptor

observations: index 0 is ALWAYS the start room (shape s) in all four layouts
exactly one goal (shape g) per layout, and it is NOT last — valley, snowfield and paru all place rooms after it
room counts are 8, 9, 9 and 10 — well under the 20 the array can hold
every generated name exists as a real file in scene/<NN>/a/, so the vocabulary is respected
all four used variant 'a'; the 'b' art variant did not appear in this sample
